hardRules: House style only: near-black stage, warm off-white type, one gold accent (src/lib/tokens.ts). No other colours.
Every cut, word landing and accent sits on the 120 BPM grid in src/videos/Teaser/beats.ts (beat = 0.5 s). Audio and picture are built from the same numbers.
No AI footage in this cut: the plan was Remotion-only (0 generation credits). Any regenerated shot needs a new storyboard version and an approved quote.
Headlines break into balanced lines with no orphan word, in every format; portrait lines are set explicitly where needed.
The 9:16 cut-down starts on the title (no cold open), keeps every later scene the same length, and trims the audio by 4.0 s so the final hit still lands on the end card.

credits.notes: Deterministic; fully owned, no licence needed

visualNotes: Stage: radial gradient #1F1D1A → #0B0B0D, film look (`<Grade look="film">`), vignette 0.3–0.45, animated grain 5–7% over everything.
Headlines: Inter 900, tight leading; the key word in gold ("speed", "format.").
Overlines and sublines: Inter 600, letter-spacing 0.2–0.32em, uppercase, muted #9A958C.
Pills and badges: gold #E8B44A fill, near-black text, fully rounded.

motionVocabulary.name: Beam sweep
motionVocabulary.how: A 100° linear-gradient band (screen blend) travels −35% → 135% of the width over 0.3–3.3 s with ease.inOut; each screen's glow = exp(−((x−beam)/0.22w)²).

motionVocabulary.name: Kick pulse
motionVocabulary.how: On the 3.5 s kick: screen borders turn gold and brightness spikes, decaying as exp(−frames/5); a 12% gold screen-blend flash.

motionVocabulary.name: Title slam
motionVocabulary.how: KineticTitle with `landOn` = the beat frames; each word springs (snappy) 0.45 s before it lands; the gold rule draws over 0.7 s after the last word.

motionVocabulary.name: Stamp
motionVocabulary.how: FOR APPROVAL (orange) fades in at 0.4 s; APPROVED (green) punches in at 9.0 s, scale 1.7 → 1 with the punch spring, rotated −8°.

motionVocabulary.name: Wipe reveal
motionVocabulary.how: clip-path inset reveals the frozen rendered frame (frame 75 of DemoTitle) over the sketch, 2.5–3.5 s, with a glowing gold edge.

motionVocabulary.name: Tile pop
motionVocabulary.how: Format tiles land on beats 12.5–14.5 s: translateY 60 → 0 and scale 0.7 → 1 (snappy), 8 frames of travel.

motionVocabulary.name: Wordmark punch
motionVocabulary.how: On the 16 s hit: letter-spacing 0.45 → 0.06em and scale 1.15 → 1, gold flash 0.5 → 0 over 8 frames, slow pull-out 1.08 → 1, fade to black in the last 0.6 s.

adaptations.notes: Starts at the title (16 s). Title at 104 px in a 900 px box (two lines). Sketch frame 86% width. Heading set as two explicit lines; tiles in two rows ([16:9, 1:1], [9:16, 4:5, A3]). End card wordmark on two lines, subline on two lines.

music.madeWith: Node synthesis: kick, hats, clap, drone, riser, A-major chord
music.notes: Drone bed swells 0–3.5 s and dips before the hit; noise riser 2.0–3.5 s; kicks on quarter notes 3.5–15.5 s; final hit at 16 s with a chord that rings to 20 s.

soundDesign.purpose: Wordmark punch; rings out to the fade

notes: The synthesised track measures about −12 LUFS raw; finishing brings it to −14.
AAC padding made the first master 20.10 s; the loudnorm script trims audio to the picture length.

buildNotes: Regenerate the soundtrack first if it's missing: `node jobs/demo/sound.mjs`.
4K renders on a 4-vCPU cloud container took 8 min 17 s (16:9) and 6 min 55 s (9:16).
qaChecklist: Every word lands on its beat (check stills at 4.25, 4.5 … 5.5 s).
No near-black frame at the 12 s cut other than the sparse heading frame (blackdetect may flag 12.00–12.27 s; that is expected).
The 9:16 heading reads "One brief." / "Every format."; no orphan words anywhere.
pitfalls: `<Freeze>` inside a single-frame `<Still>` shows frame 0. Land animations in the past (negative `landOn`) instead.
Google Fonts can't load in the cloud container's Chromium (proxy certificate). Fonts are bundled locally.
Remotion's bundled ffmpeg lacks blackdetect, lut3d, tile and fps. QC and contact sheets use a system ffmpeg.
blackdetect flags sparse dark frames (a few words on near-black) as black; review the flagged frames before acting.
In portrait, flex-wrapped headlines broke as "One brief. Every / format."; set the lines explicitly.
